bar: sim_actor beats random and every blind heuristic on real held-out replay
disclosures: Stationarity within the diagnostic session is assumed: b_full defines the student-as-of-now, and imagined answers are drawn from that student — 'what would they do if asked today' — not from their historical selves. The measured size of the historical-drift caveat is V3's 0.7225, disclosed beside every curve; within-session learning from the asked questions themselves is the action-effect channel, explicitly outside this claim's scope.
b_full plays the part the real student plays at deployment — it generates answers and defines success; it is never an input to the deployed policy.
